card_desc: Paste in how you spent your week. Claude sorts every task into delegate, automate or drop, and picks the first thing to hand off.

sub: Sort your week into delegate, automate or drop. Then hand one thing off.

sections.label: How to use it
sections.title: From busy week to one hand-off

steps.title: Write down where your hours went
steps.text: A simple list of tasks and time is fine.

steps.title: Paste it into Claude with this prompt
steps.text: Paste your list into Claude, then add this:
steps.prompt: Here is how I spent my week. Sort every task into 3 lists: delegate (someone else could do it), automate (a tool or AI could do it), or drop (it doesn't need doing). For each one say why in one line. Then tell me the one thing to hand off first and how.

steps.title: Hand one thing off
steps.text: Pick one and hand it off this week.
